tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i skong bshags shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ 1$0000290

rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i skong bshags rnams grangs mang po gsog pa lta bu'i tshe/ las gzhung gang la brten pa'i skong bshags rgyas pa tshar gcig sngon du song nas/ skong gtor sogs gso bran byas la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ mchod gtor dang skong rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo'i sprin chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes brtag pa bzhis byin gyis brlabs la/ mchog gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ khyad par brgyud gsum dam can rgya mtsho dang*// nor lha gter bdag 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs shig /bde stong ting 'dzin rol pa las byung ba'i// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i phyag rgya ches// thugs dam gnyan po chos kyi dbyings su bskang*// sdom dang dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul bshags// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi zhing*// bsam pa'i don kun chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// ces tshar grangs ji ltar rigs pa'i mjug gzhung gi rjes chog sogs dkyus ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang padma gar gyi dbang phyug gi bkas rjes su gnang ba la brten nas/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ //
